source_scope.butterfly_denominator: INBO present 42 unique butterflies on 18 named Macaronesian islands
source_scope.canary_origin_census: All 33 INBO Canary butterflies independently classified using Canary BIOTA source species pages
source_scope.original_HOSTS: GloBI mirror NHM HOSTS fixed commit 808e0b869f9ec1adf8efff87cf6a395adda103e0, n=140485 raw rows
source_scope.wcvp: matildabrown/rWCVPdata commit 65bed76bae9d644ccb6ad200c05f9f5071d89e05, native/introduced exact species in Level3 CNY

butterfly_taxon_ascertainment.inference: Confirmed minimum of named larval-host genera in selected sources, not statistically unbiased biological true known-host coverage

original_GEB_selection.newly_confirmed_relation: INBO Colias crocea = GEB Colias croceus, homotypic via NCBI Taxonomy 72248
original_GEB_selection.note: Confirmed minimum; potential unverified taxonomic synonym identity or selection failures remain

single_uniform_source.method: Same source, deterministic species page URL for all 33; only CICLO VITAL explicit larval foodplant genera, no adult PLANTAS VISITADAS
single_uniform_source.conceptual_boundary: These p-values describe a documentation mechanism; evolutionary independence, historical availability, and species-concept alignment are not assumed.

independent_Canary_origin_full33.caveat: Canary BIOTA region-specific native probable/secure labels; Cacyreus marshalli/Pieris rapae uncertainty explicitly kept.

strict_limitations: Accepted WCVP introduced species in the same genus are not demonstrated larval hosts, even when the butterfly has been documented feeding on some species of that genus.
Level3 CNY is the Canary archipelago, not individual butterfly island distributions or dated wild plant presence.
Kew WCVP introduced means wild introduced, not merely cultivated in gardens, so garden host records can be missed.
Native and alien in same genus cannot be used to reconstruct the original GEB species-level native-to-contemporary resource opportunity for endemic butterflies.
No larval survival, colonization, shipping or ocean-transport mechanism was measured.

final_scientific_decision.retain_old_GEB_result: +54.9% global and +118.9% selected island butterflies' potential known-host resource geography; original estimand unchanged
final_scientific_decision.supported_new_result: Independent island species HOSTS selection/ascertainment bias varies by archipelago and clade, recoverable in other sources and remains conditional on taxonomic identity.
final_scientific_decision.newly_identified_necessary_gate: Larval host PLANT SPECIES identity and original island-level native/alien plant range plus performance to infer actual endemic resource expansion.
final_scientific_decision.not_supported: Generalizing the numerical +54.9%/+118.9% host-opportunity response to all indigenous endemic island butterflies.
